name: unreal-bp
description: Unreal Editor library for Codex. Reads and edits Blueprint graphs through commands using the existing local Unreal MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Read and edit Blueprints through commands.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-side Unreal library for Blueprint maps and command files: create events, variables and nodes, connect pins, position and arrange nodes, compile and save through the existing Unreal MCP server.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read the graph map of a Blueprint in the connected Unreal Editor.
